content: Unattended catch-up (Idle Champions, Clicker Heroes, Antimatter Dimensions, Yokai Idle Apr 2026, cross-checked): approximating offline progress from a recorded rate diverges from the live sim; Yokai Idle shipped a 5x-speed exploit from delta-time mismatch and had to add search/respawn delays and food thresholds the approximation skipped; then hit 13s freezes and coarsened ticks 100ms->500ms. Lesson: one rule set for watched and unwatched; tick rate is a tunable with precision/cost tradeoff.
